t: 80/20, Nix, and Vim: Architecting a Local-First Workflow
s: This article explores optimizing local-first workflows using Nix and Vim, emphasizing the 80/20 rule to avoid project rabbit holes and focus on essential tasks. It contrasts Nix's clean system management with traditional installers and highlights the 80/20 approach to file transfer for local video editing.
sub: 80/20 rule application for workflow optimization and avoiding project tangents.
Nix package manager for clean, non-polluting local system management compared to traditional installers.
Local-first workflow strategies for technical tasks, particularly video editing, leveraging tools like USB drives and cross-platform file systems (exFAT).
The strategic use of 'uninstalling' Nix as an introduction to its benefits, proving its non-polluting nature.
